error_model.logging: Does not log; raises exceptions for invalid usage.
raises: SpellSpaceScopeError when meld/reset is called without an active spellspace or storage
RuntimeError if used after cleanup via Cleanable.check_cleaned

side_effects: Delegates meld calls to the owning Conduit
Unregisters from the owner Conduit during cleanup

runtime_couplings: Relies on Conduit spellspace registration and active scope checks
Uses Creations storage to clear spellspace-scoped instances

dependents.notes: Used by Conduit to provide spellspace-scoped resolution.

integration_flow: Create or enter a spellspace on a Conduit
Call SpellSpace.meld to resolve a spell in that scope
Reset or cleanup to clear spellspace-bound instances

usage_snippets.code:
with conduit.enter_spellspace() as space:
    result = space.meld(spell='spell_id')
usage_snippets.title: Use a spellspace scope

order_constraints: Call reset before unregistering from the owner conduit

lifecycle.construction: Creates a unique ID and sets initial version to 0.
lifecycle.ownership: Owns spellspace identity and version; holds an owner conduit reference.

invariants: SpellSpace must be active on its owner to meld
SpellSpace id is stable for its lifetime
non_goals: Does not manage global spell lifecycles
pitfalls: Calling meld outside an active spellspace scope
responsibilities: Represent a spellspace scope and versioning

summary.detail: Scope handle used by Conduit to enforce spellspace-scoped resolution and lifecycle resets.
summary.one_liner: Manages a Conduit spellspace scope and version.

coverage_expectations: meld raises when spellspace is not active
reset clears spellspace instances and increments version
cleanup unregisters spellspace from the owner
